find:
.select({ id: contacts.id, ownerId: contacts.ownerId, companyId: contacts.companyId })
    .from(contacts)
    .where(sql`lower(${contacts.email}) = ${s.email}`)
replace:
.select({ id: contacts.id, ownerId: contacts.ownerId, companyId: contacts.companyId })
    .from(contacts)
    .where(eq(contacts.email, s.email))
